summary: RED candidate for the M12 Jobs lifecycle root shared by Issues #59/#60/#74. New focused tests require createRlmJobSpec to remain inert until run(), require job-owned cancellation through an AbortSignal, and require cancelling one job to leave sibling jobs and the shared RlmRuntime alive.

pointers: Issue#60/#74: createRlmJobSpec is inert until the official registry calls run()
Issue#59/#74: killing one job aborts only that cell
Issue#59/#74: cancelling one job leaves a sibling job

steps: Froze the M12 producer contract against the official JobRegistry rule that run() is the sole work-start boundary and cancel() is synchronous/idempotent but settles done only after producer cleanup.
Built a ControlledRuntime test double that records eval inputs/signals and dispose calls without starting Python.

Added RED assertions for inert spec construction, per-job AbortSignal cancellation, zero runtime.dispose() calls from job kill, and sibling job survival on one shared runtime. Production src/runtime.ts is intentionally untouched in this RED candidate.

evidence.note: Current code constructs the done Promise and calls runtime.eval during spec construction; cancel invokes runtime.dispose(), matching the reported root causes in #59/#60/#74.
PR CI will execute the new focused tests against the untouched production code to preserve explicit RED evidence before the runtime patch.

limitations: Production code is intentionally not changed in this record; a successor GREEN record will own the runtime patch.
The tests isolate producer lifecycle only; query/session bridge parity remains Issue #78 and same-Session job admission remains Issue #86.
